stage: Designed before Qwen inference or task scoring; offline only after prediction seal.
component_attribution: For every valid native 3D box substitute the GT camera bearing, optical depth, sorted upright dimensions and axial yaw in all 16 combinations. Average each component's marginal IoU or strict accuracy change over the 24 orders. The four components sum to the gap from the raw box to perfect geometry. Report all frames with a valid box and condition separately on independently measured 2D identification. This decomposition allocates geometric error and cannot partition semantic causes.
case_visuals: First anonymized UID in each specified outcome group. Original RGB and annotated drawings remain local.
data_use: Ordinary data only. No effect on selection of prompt, thresholds or boxes.
